## History

Fred Wright gathered with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and other friends at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in shared dismay after the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) hall was mistakenly painted bright blue. He later became engaged to [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stumbled upon them sharing an intimate moment. Fred eventually married [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), and the couple later welcomed a newborn baby boy.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P24](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0024), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), +11 more_

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--fred-wright.md)

Fred became engaged to [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) after the two shared a private, romantic bond. They later married at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), eventually starting a family together and having a newborn baby boy.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), +16 more_

- Romantically involved with — engaged to be married  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P18](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0018), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P30](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0030), +3 more</sub>
- Spouse of — married at Orchard Slope (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Proposal P26](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0026), [v3 ch.Atonement” P20](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0020), [v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013), +1 more</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fred-wright--gilbert-blythe.md)

Fred and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are comrades who both serve as officers and members of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Along with their mutual friends, they participate in local community matters, including gathering to express shared dismay over town mishaps like a botched hall painting job.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048), [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), +3 more_

- Comrade of — fellow officer and member of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028)</sub>
